derivation:
by simpa only [← Set.range_comp, DirectedOn, Directed, Set.forall_mem_range, Set.exists_range_iff] using
  (directedOn_image (r := r) (f := g) (s := Set.range f))
explanation: Specialize directedOn_image to the range of f. Unfolding directedness and simplifying quantifiers over ranges gives the target. Its proof is independent of directed_comp.
